capabilities: Mark a note as extending a parent note via an 'extends' frontmatter property
Look up note objects by link or path and test isDescendantOf from JavaScript
Define custom functions and reuse them with JavaScript loader plugins like CustomJS
disambiguation: Not an object-oriented programming tool; it applies inheritance-like links between notes, not code.
problem: Obsidian has no notion of note inheritance, so properties that many notes share must be duplicated in each note's frontmatter.

relations.evidence: You can define your own functions like this or use javascript loader plugins like CustomJS

summary: Inheritance plugin that lets a note extend a parent note through an 'extends' frontmatter property and query descendant relationships from JavaScript.
